name: @conductor/mcp-server
description: Conductor's central MCP server — exposes recipes, skills, triggers, plugins, inbox, threads, approvals, and stub surfaces for artifacts/views/search/signals to the side-terminal CLI and external agents. Wraps the local <project_dir>/.conductor/ workspace; reads + writes recipe/skill/trigger/plugin files and keeps inbox/thread/approval state in-memory in this stub (real Conductor uses better-sqlite3). See docs/superpowers/specs/2026-05-09-conductor-simplified-design.md §6.1 for the tool catalog and §10.4 for scope semantics.
